thresholds.description: XP to reach each level, from level 1 (0): the 2024 PHB's Character Advancement table. The game stops at StoryState.LEVEL_CAP; the entry after it is the ceiling arithmetic's, not a level the party reaches.

budgets.description: The 2024 DMG's XP budget per character at each level from 1: [Low, Moderate, High].

foe_share.description: The share of a foe's stat-block XP the party earns (the game's fights field far more foes than the book's).

split.description: What a fight's XP divides by: a party of four, whoever travels.

awards.description: What each kind of award is worth to each hero: `times` the budget column at the party's level.

withdraw_pays.description: A monster id -> the award that pays when it leaves a fight alive (Strahd withdraws; his stat block's XP waits for his end).

milestone_quests.description: Quests whose success is a region's milestone: the milestone pays for them, so their own ending pays nothing more.

no_xp_quests.description: Quests that never pay (the walk out of the mists).
